sloka: बालो बताय मैक्ष्वाकश्चिरम् राज्यमकारयत् ।यदा तु बहवो वृद्धा गुणवन्तो बहुश्रुताह् ॥२-१२-६५॥
transliteration: bālo batāya maikṣvākaściram rājyamakārayat ।yadā tu bahavo vṛddhā guṇavanto bahuśrutāh ॥2-12-65॥

translations.english: When several virtuous and learned elders ask me about Rama, what shall I tell them?
